name: Robot Defense
desc:
We are going to be recontinuing Robot Tower Defense in hopes of making it available for everyone!

You're in the future and technology has advanced. But technology has advanced too much...

🤖 Robots are now taking over! Send out your towers to protect your base from destruction. You're our only hope for survival from these robots.

--Other stuff

All of the music in this game "IS NOT" made by me. Give credits to the original owners

Credits to: Spourk1, Him_GX2, Brentril, ulus1977_TestingAcc, SeedEmperor, SkellyAnimator, [REDACTED], and catcrdnf for helping the game out!

This game was inspired by Ragdoll Factory's Robo-Ragdoll robots

(Most of the game's code was made from a Gnomecode tutorial video)
